input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The change from re.match to fullmatch silently alters which exceptions match a regex. A pattern that previously matched a prefix of the message no longer matches.
- rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout") is used with an exception whose str is "timeout occurred". Before this change, match() succeeded and the call was retried; after it, fullmatch() fails and the call is not retried. The commit title only announces accepting an empty message, so this unannounced change to matching semantics is not covered by the stated intent. Impact: existing users' retry predicates stop firing on messages that previously matched, so operations fail without retry.
critique: Both describe the same mechanism. The regex check now requires a full-message match (fullmatch), so a message with a matching prefix plus extra text fails the predicate and the call is not retried.
